name: Kodo no Mae
source:
"Princess, Why don't you try smiling a bit. I think a smiling face would suit you."

A broadminded god who excels in the art of war. Although he is kind and thoughtful, he is vicious on the battlefield. He is considered a heroic figure who holds the kind of experience that can only be gained from living through numerous battles. In everyday life, he can often be crude and irresponsible.
